description: Pepe compares two bowls so every shared pebble survives the copy.

visual_review.new_mark: Two small charcoal bowls with red ochre pebbles linked by an ochre trail on lower-left bare rock
visual_review.preservation: 3306 changed pixels inside [174,937,148,62]; zero changed pixels outside. Ancestral figures and pigment retained.
visual_review.hands: One inherited visible hand counted as four fingers and one thumb; no new hands or stencils.
limitations: Inherited rock has photographic texture. Small pigment details soften in the JPEG. Visual inspection is local judgment.
